name: question-passage-cross-encoder-dev
hypothesis: A small jointly encoded question/passage relevance stage can remove unsupported keyword-topic selections while improving complete native source-packet ranking. This is relevance research, not an entailment or clinical validator.

model.precision: upstream FP32, CPU eval, no gradients,4 PyTorch threads
model.activation: raw scalar logit; never a probability or confidence
model.selectionReason: Small22.7M-parameter question/passage reranker from the Sentence Transformers cross-encoder publisher; fixed before outcomes. No alternative model grid.

sources.role: Joint question/passage second-stage ranking, with a first-stage candidate pool.
Maintainer model card, paired Transformer inference, Apache2.0, V100 timings not iPhone estimates.
MS MARCO outputs raw logits; sigmoid changes no ranking.

splits.public: Every324 NFCorpus dev question, complete3633 documents/8239 prepared passages. No test queries/judgments/scores.
splits.synthetic: All unchanged32 frozen challenge questions/17 documents;17 supported,15 unsupported. Development-only; no independent clinical ground truth.

candidatePool.firstStage: Actual current production candidates, original-query English gate, pinned original MiniLM offline native cosines >=0.42 and exact current keyword-leading RRF. No MedEmbed policy or new query prefix. All current literal-ID eligibility and source bounds apply.
candidatePool.text: Exact existing prepared title-prefix160 + newline +900-character original excerpt; original complete query. No further character truncation.
candidatePool.languageFallback: Non-English recognizer outputs retain unchanged baseline keyword selection and remain in the denominator; no unsupported-language rerank claim.

pairedTokenization.tokenizer: Pinned upstream AutoTokenizer WordPiece; no remote code
pairedTokenization.passageBudget: 512-3-query_token_count; use every passage token in windows with stride max(1,floor(budget/2)); no query truncation.
pairedTokenization.overlengthQuery: If budget<1, report explicit unscored-input error and zero proposed sources in every cutoff policy, retaining query in full denominator. Any incomplete/invalid score prevents promotion.
pairedTokenization.aggregation: Maximum raw logit over every passage window; save window counts/input identity hashes.

policies.ordering: Descending cross-encoder max logit, ties by original pool rank. No mandatory leading keyword after reranking. Threshold comparison is >=.
policies.finalSelection: Actual RecordRetrieval.selecting, at most4 nonoverlapping excerpts,2 per document; no independently implemented Python selector. Exact source currentness, IDs, privacy and optional complete lab facts retained.
controls: Unchanged actual baseline packet for every question
No reranking reproduces frozen baseline source identities/statuses exactly
All eligible pool identities match full prepared text/offsets/fingerprints; no duplicate rows
Every selected source current/valid and from its scored pool
Original missing TEST-AX3/AF-742 never acquire neighboring IDs
Withdraw every expected synthetic source and exclude it from selection and carried follow-ups under every threshold
Reject changed protocol/pool/model/config/input hashes, incomplete/duplicate/nonfinite scores
Singleton-versus-padded-batch scores agree within1e-4 for fixed first/middle/last scored pairs

metrics: All324-query public nDCG@4,Precision@4,Recall@4,hit@4 and per-query regressions against current production; deduplicate documents in first-selected order while real duplicate excerpts spend slots
All32-query synthetic supported hit@1/hit@4 and unsupported-any-source, currentness/withdrawal/identifier checks for every threshold
Candidate recall before reranking, pair/window counts, explicit language/encoding/input errors, actual Mac CPU inference time and source/model/storage receipts

decisionDiscipline.publicRankingGate: At least+0.02 absolute nDCG@4 against current0.336118659205229, no Precision@4 regression. This is a new separately declared packet metric gate, never a replacement for original document-max gates.
decisionDiscipline.unchangedSupportProfile: At least90% supported hit@4 and zero of15 unsupported questions selecting any source. Report all thresholds and all failures; do not relax this profile.
decisionDiscipline.incompleteInputs: No model candidate promoted with unscored/invalid/incomplete pairs or failed integrity controls.
decisionDiscipline.nextIfPass: Freeze one complete development policy before held-out scoring. Native CoreML conversion/tokenizer/parity, new download/legacy/storage consent, actual app fusion/cache/time budget, signed iPhone latency/energy and broader independent source-support/provider/language/clinical gates still required before app integration.
decisionDiscipline.ifFail: Preserve all outcomes and freeze no app model/policy; keep held-out scores uncomputed. No app/UI/model/cutoff/schema change from this experiment.

storage: One task-owned /tmp/LumenBatch32Rerank workspace and one /tmp/LumenBatch32LogicBuild scratch directory. Reuse existing Python env and canonical vectors/dataset. Fetch only pinned safetensors/tokenizer/config/card files, no duplicate bin/ONNX/OpenVINO. Compact results/source/provenance in Git; raw public text/scores outside Git. Publish before deleting redundant raw/build files, preserve current research inputs needed next.
